name: Chamroeun Hongleng
headline: Building intelligent systems with technical depth, business understanding, and responsible governance.
identity: Dual-degree student — Information Technology Management at AUPP and Computer Science at Fort Hays State — building with CHNAI LAB in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
intro: I am exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence, machine learning, software, and business. I want to understand not only how intelligent systems are built, but also how contracts, policies, risks, and business decisions shape how those systems should be designed and used.
My long-term aspiration is to build practical AI products that are technically sound, useful to real people, commercially valuable, and responsibly governed.
availability: Open to applied-ML research, internships, product collaborations, and governance learning opportunities.

proofPoints.text: Built a complete Khmer speech-recognition fine-tuning pipeline on Whisper-small — data preparation, training, evaluation, export, and an installable CLI, all public.
Best self-reported checkpoint: 17.48% character error rate on the project's own evaluation split. Weights and audio are not yet published, so the number is not externally reproducible.
Designed a deterministic farm-lot decision engine with 62 unit tests, CI, and bilingual Khmer/English audit reports — running on synthetic data by design.
Top 2 placement, Turing Hackathon Cycle 10 (Market Access for Farmers track), with the Chomkar OrderLoop concept.
Studying Information Technology Management at AUPP and Computer Science at Fort Hays State University while working with contracts, terms, and policy questions through international business studies.

aiWorkingStyle: I work AI-natively: AI tools (primarily Claude) support my research, drafting, and implementation, while decisions, evidence labels, and anything that ships stay under human review — mine.
